title: Aromatic Silky Thai Chicken Curry
description: This briny and silky Thai dish features a rich and aromatic sauce, whisked to perfection, making it a paleo-friendly delight, evoking nostalgic memories of traditional Thai cuisine.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the paste is fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is fully cooked.
Use a whisk to stir the sauce and create a silky texture.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs or chilies if desired.
